shard.name: Adminer
shard.description: Ultra-lightweight, full-featured web-based database management tool supporting MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite with a clean dark theme.
shard.author: Jakub Vrána & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Adminer Database Manager Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${ADMINER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${ADMINER_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    ADMINER_VERSION="4.8.1"
fi

echo "Downloading Adminer v${ADMINER_VERSION}..."
curl -sSL -o index.php "https://github.com/vrana/adminer/releases/download/v${ADMINER_VERSION}/adminer-${ADMINER_VERSION}.php"

echo "Downloading sleek dark theme for Adminer..."
curl -sSL -o adminer.css "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vrana/adminer/master/designs/dracula/adminer.css" || true

echo "Adminer installation completed successfully!"
